issues.en: Surname taken from the margin (entry text Канчевъ is the same name); Lithuanian form reconstructed from -ev. Village name Merkeliar and the husband's surname Garbengiad uncertain. Priest's name begins with a dropped letter (ацевичемъ), read as Pacewicz.
